## Collaboration, Advising, and Professional Engagement

I welcome opportunities to contribute methodological expertise, evidentiary reasoning, and academic leadership experience to ambitious research, professional development, and advisory work.

I am especially interested in engagements involving serious commitment to learning, strong scholarship, and the potential for meaningful professional or scholarly impact.

## Research Collaboration

> The strongest methodological collaboration begins early, when measurement, design, and analysis can be developed together.

I contribute most effectively when methodological decisions are integrated with the substantive goals of a project from the beginning.

::: {.engagement-grid}

::: {.engagement-card}

<span class="engagement-label">Research</span>

### Grant and Research Collaboration

Participation as a co-investigator, methodological lead, evaluator, statistical consultant, or research collaborator.

Typical contributions include:

- research design;
- measurement planning;
- analytic strategy;
- grant-methods development;
- interpretation of evidence;
- methodological writing.

:::

::: {.engagement-card}

<span class="engagement-label">Methods</span>

### Measurement and Analysis

Methodological guidance involving:

- latent variable modeling;
- psychometrics;
- classification;
- categorical-data analysis;
- multilevel modeling;
- generalized linear models;
- model evaluation;
- simulation studies.

:::

::: {.engagement-card}

<span class="engagement-label">Evaluation</span>

### Evaluation and Evidentiary Review

Support for projects requiring:

- evaluation design;
- measurement review;
- analytic review;
- validity arguments;
- interpretation of findings;
- assessment of evidentiary strength;
- external methodological review.

:::

::: {.engagement-card}

<span class="engagement-label">Advisory</span>

### Panels, Boards, and Review

Service may include:

- advisory boards;
- scientific committees;
- proposal-review panels;
- external review;
- methodological advisory roles;
- research-development consultation.

:::

:::

## Speaking and Workshops

I am available for keynote talks, invited presentations, workshops, panel discussions, executive briefings, and professional-development sessions.

::: {.topic-columns}

Topics may include:

- factor analysis;

- classification;

::: {.topic-panel}

Topics may include:

- promotion and tenure;

## Fit and Boundaries

I am most interested in opportunities where my methodological expertise or academic-leadership experience can contribute meaningfully to stronger research, better decisions, and deeper learning.

I generally decline collaborations that:

- fall substantially outside my methodological preparation;
- require me to make substantive or theoretical decisions that properly belong to domain experts;
- involve methodological participation only after major design or measurement decisions are fixed;
- do not allow sufficient time for careful and responsible work.

Effective interdisciplinary collaboration depends on clear roles, mutual respect, and serious integration of complementary expertise.

## Discuss an Engagement

::: {.engagement-cta}

### Describe the Opportunity

I consider invitations involving research collaboration, grant development, methodological advising, evaluation, speaking, workshops, panels, review, and advisory service.

Please include a brief description of:

- the project or opportunity;
- the anticipated role;
- the current stage of development;
- the intended audience;
- timing;
- whether the engagement is virtual, in-person, or flexible.
